data.action: 单膝跪地调试装甲关节
data.description: 【泥岩 · 装甲整备】罗德岛重型装备工坊内，身形娇小的泥岩单膝跪在巨大的重型动力防护服旁，一丝不苟地调试着液压关节与厚重的合金装甲板。擦去脸颊上的机油灰尘后，她转过脸露出纯净的微笑——「这套装甲虽然沉重笨拙，但只要能穿上它守护同伴，我就不会感到丝毫疲惫。」
data.promptProse: Mudrock kneels beside the towering powered armor, guiding a wrench into its exposed leg hydraulic joint with a gauntleted hand. Heavy plates sit nearby; black high-neck bodysuit, remaining pauldrons, silver-white hair and Sarkaz horns stay visible above an oil-smudged focused face. The medium view includes the open toolkit on concrete. Workshop lamps glint on steel and the joint, throwing the armor's broad shadow behind her and small tool shadows across the floor.
data.title: 泥岩 · 装甲整备
